title: The office
logline: The mill office, 1994: a calendar on its last month, a typewriter, a coffee ring, a notice on the door's glass seen from behind so its words are backward and unlettered. The manager's chair empty. Where the sentence was said, before it was.

panels.composition: A small mill office: a wall calendar on its last page, a typewriter, a coffee ring on a desk, an empty swivel chair, and a paper notice taped to the door's glass seen from inside so its lettering is backward and unreadable.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a small mill office with a wall calendar on its last page, a typewriter, a coffee ring on a desk, an empty swivel chair and a paper notice taped to the door's glass seen from inside with its lettering backward and unreadable, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The notice backward. The chair empty.
